Verdict: needs_changes. The implementer declared `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)` correctly, and `target_context.commands_run` is empty, so no forbidden command shapes there.

FINDING (high, security): Evidence sanitization still allows common npm auth-token values to persist. Evidence: `_apply_secret_patterns()` leaves `npm install --//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_[redacted-test-token]` unchanged, and `evaluate_command_template()` returns `True passes allowlist policy` for that same `npm install` command, so an attempted allowlisted step can write the raw token into `command_template`/`argv`. Recommendation: redact npm token forms such as `_authToken=...`, `authToken=...`, `auth_token=...`, and `npm_...`, and add regression tests covering an allowlisted npm command with those fields.

FINDING (medium, documentation): Parent roadmap still does not record V2 completion. Evidence: D013 says “V2 is in progress” and “A subsequent D-entry will record V2 close-out once F003 ships features.json passes:true,” while F003 acceptance requires the parent roadmap update after V2 completion. Recommendation: when closing F003, add/amend the parent D-entry to state V2 is complete and cite the final F003 evidence/signoff.
